intro: A blackened skull is the darkened cranial remnant of a Darkeye Bonecaster animating in the Agamand Mills. Deathguard Dillinger in Brill demands these grisly trophies as proof of thinning the mindless Scourge forces threatening Tirisfal Glades.

p: These blackened skulls are salvaged from the Darkeye Bonecasters haunting the Agamand Mills. These skeletal spellcasters direct necromantic malice against the living and the Forsaken alike, attempting to entrench a forward base for the Lich King's armies in northern Tirisfal. Presenting their ruined skulls to Deathguard Dillinger serves as tangible evidence that the Scourge's mystical vanguard is being crushed.
